safety_limits: sanitized metadata and synthetic fixtures only
no GitHub mutation, runtime connection, SQL execution, backup, restore, deployment, or production operation
candidate/static evidence does not establish reachability, runtime behavior, authorization, recovery success, RPO, or RTO
all product/runtime/CI results remain NOT_RUN until an eligible fenced lease and required environments exist
title: Candidate report, reachability, scoped export and artifact authorization fixtures
non_inferences: packaged candidate is not a reachable menu/report
31 subreport controls are not 31 unique reports
RPX script is not executable in the Web client
one metadata binding does not generalize to all reports
grid visibility does not grant export/status/download
report run snapshot does not enable SQL SNAPSHOT isolation

cases.synthetic_trigger: candidate RPX has no current menu/runtime invocation proof
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: current build menu path, capability, invocation trace and source identity

cases.synthetic_trigger: parent report requested while a packaged subreport dependency is absent
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: complete parent/subreport manifest, hashes and engine load proof

cases.synthetic_trigger: RPX contains embedded C# or VB.NET script
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: refuse client execution and require reviewed server disposition
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: script behavior inventory and parity tests

cases.synthetic_trigger: role may view grid but lacks export capability
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: deny export dispatch with no count/data leak
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: server export policy and denied-role test

cases.synthetic_trigger: role is revoked or company scope changes after job dispatch
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: reauthorize status and download; deny foreign/stale context
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: scoped job/artifact identity and revoke tests

cases.synthetic_trigger: CSV cell begins with =, +, -, or @ from untrusted text
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: round-trip formula safety test in target spreadsheet consumers

cases.synthetic_trigger: lost acknowledgement after long report submission
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: reconcile durable job identity before retry
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: idempotent dispatch/reconciliation contract and retained run reference

cases.synthetic_trigger: masked field omitted in UI but requested via filter/sort/total/export
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: reject unauthorized field operation without inference leak

cases.synthetic_trigger: report output is labeled snapshot without timezone, parameters or data-as-of
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: do not claim immutable run identity
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: documented consistency method and run metadata

cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: do not accept parity from screenshot
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: machine-decode acceptance using reviewed symbology/content rules

cases.synthetic_trigger: direct data-call identifier is present in one RPX family
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: do not execute or infer signature/permission
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: B2 object identity, parameters, dependencies and least-privilege adapter review

cases.synthetic_trigger: bounded named examples are mistaken for the full 786-report inventory
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: source-set-equal stable-ID manifest with zero omitted/duplicate members

cases.synthetic_trigger: job is queued under scope generation A then worker starts after role/company generation B
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: worker reauthorizes immutable job scope immediately before execution and refuses stale/widened authority
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: queued-worker dispatch fence with principal/scope/capability generation test

cases.synthetic_trigger: queued job payload is edited or rebound to a broader report/parameter set
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: immutable request fingerprint and registered report contract mismatch reject dispatch
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: durable immutable job envelope and tamper test

cases.synthetic_trigger: artifact is generated correctly but storage key or download token crosses tenant/company scope
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: artifact namespace and token stay narrow; download reauthorizes current scope
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: cross-scope storage/token isolation and expiry test

cases.synthetic_trigger: report job succeeds after requester loses access
cases.expected_fail_closed_behavior: retain operational result per policy but deny status/content visibility and do not notify unauthorized principal
cases.required_evidence_to_pass: revocation test across dispatch, completion, status, notification and download
